difficulty_reason: Reformulation of representability of a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids: unpacks the Algebraic Stacks representability criterion into the statement that every 2-fibre product (Sch/U)_fppf x_{y,Y} X is of the form (Sch/V_y)_fppf, then rewrites its objects as triples (h : V -> U, x, alpha : f(x) -> h^*y) with alpha over id_V, drops h, and shows the resulting data is exactly an object x with a morphism f(x) -> y, i.e. representability of the functor in (2) with universal object f(x_y) -> y. Retained author proof at lines 816-832.
